description: Experiment configuration: maps quality-benchmark case IDs to curriculum domains. Not gold answers; contains no topic lists.

selection_rationale.frontend_engineering: Frozen expansion batch: high stable missing-edge impact across HTML/React/perf/a11y cases.
selection_rationale.backend_engineering: Frozen expansion batch: core API/auth/transactions/caching product domain.
selection_rationale.databases: Frozen expansion batch: foundational SQL/indexing/distributed-DB/normalization curriculum.
selection_rationale.data_engineering: Frozen expansion batch: ETL/warehouse/quality for remaining DE cases (stream_processing stays separate).
